title: Add new release repositories
author: huchijwk
body:
* Name of the release team: 42dot

* Release repositories to add:
  * [foros](https://github.com/42dot/foros)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: <RELEASE REPOSITORY URL>

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
@huchijwk this release repository was added when I created the new team for https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/issues/141

Is there an additional release repository for another project or can this issue be closed?

comments.author: huchijwk
comments.body: @nuclearsandwich Thanks for your reply. I checked that `42dot-release` was created, is it correct that the release repository is created with the team name not repository name, `foros-release`?

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: 🤦🏼 That was me typing faster than I was thinking. I'll open a PR to change the repo name and rename it. Sorry for the trouble.

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: The latest change renaming the release repository is deploying now.
